name: arif-fazil.com MCP
description: Canonical MCP gateway for the arifOS federation. All tool execution routes through mcp.arif-fazil.com/mcp.

transport.stateless_explanation: This endpoint runs in stateless mode (per MCP 2025-11-25 streamable-http). Does NOT emit mcp-session-id on initialize; subsequent calls do not require session continuity. For stateful arifOS 8-verb circuit, use arif_seal mode=receipt.

discovery_chain: Per MCP 2025-11-25 §.well-known/mcp/server.json is the spec canonical discovery path.
